slides.headline: “mercury retrograde breaks your *phone*”
slides.dek: it starts tuesday. let's check the claim first

slides.headline: “mercury retrograde breaks your phone”
slides.body: nothing about mercury touches your phone. a retrograde is a change in how the planet looks from earth, not a force. phones break all year, we just notice in retrograde.

slides.headline: *mercury* doesn't reverse. earth overtakes it
slides.body: mercury laps the sun faster than we do. as it swings past, it looks like it slides back: from 6° pisces on feb 9 to 20.9° aquarius on mar 3.

slides.headline: a season for *re-dos*: read twice, then reconnect
slides.body: astrologers read mercury as talk and plans, so its retrograde reads as a time to slow down, double-check, and finish old conversations before starting new ones.
